messages:
reena: Quick heads-up  strict fncall schema validation rolled to canary (route=doc_search_v3). Console shows a small but visible spike in hard rejects (~0.6% of canary). Most failing calls are coming from partner adapters. Need an ops playbook.

elena: Validator owner here. We enabled strict to catch regressions. Were reject events sampled or full-counted? I want to avoid noisy pages.

reena: Canary telemetry was 100% for visibility. Ops is getting alerts. Can we soften without losing telemetry?

tom: Routing owner. Short-term options: 1) revert to permissive; 2) set validator to warn-mode (log metric + return 200); 3) quarantine partners to a compat variant. (2) seems quickest.

elena: I can flip to warn-mode for the canary route only. Implementation: increment metric `fncall.schema_warns` (tags: route, partner, model), return 200 with header `X-Redwood-Fncall: validation=warn`, and set `tool_passthrough:true` so callers aren't broken. Also add `ingest_origin:canary_warn` tag on metrics/samples so backfills won't double-count.

sam: From logs, example failing payload:
```json
{"fn":"doc_search_v3","res":[{"id":"abc","snippet":"..."}],"meta":{"partner":"pdf-bridge"}}
```
We expect `res` to be an object `{items:[...], total:int}` so single-array shapes fail.

reena: Ops ask: capture a small sample (0.5%) of warn events to s3://fncall/validation-samples with partner+route tags (PII redaction). Also add a dashboard tile that splits `schema_warns` by `partner` + `route_id` and highlights canary slice. Current model-level view hides partner hotspots.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: warn-mode toggle requested by @elena for route doc_search_v3 (canary only). CI quick checks passed. ETA ~6m.

elena: I'll add the sampling hook and the `ingest_origin` tag. Patch will increment `fncall.schema_warns` and still return success responses.

tom: For routing: I'll prototype a quarantine list that maps partner ids -> compat variant `doc_search_compat`. Ops can add partners to the list as we identify them; runtime will route accordingly. That avoids changing validator globally.

sam: Please also add a quick console link from the dashboard tile to the samples bucket so SRE/product can triage faster.

elena: Patch merged; warn-mode active for the canary. Telemetry shows warn metric increasing but no client 4xxs. Sampling hook live.

reena: Thanks. Action items: tom -> quarantine list prototype + perf check; sam -> collect top partner offenders from samples and tag account teams; elena -> postmortem with metric counts + query (include `ingest_origin` filters). We'll reconvene after 24h to decide whether to quarantine or require adapter fixes. :white_check_mark:
